name: EMOM — Dumbbell Base 20
description: Accessible full-body EMOM that builds repeatable muscular output without race-style modality integration.
coaching_notes: Choose loads that preserve 15-25s rest each minute. Do not chase failure.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 20 min (5 rounds)
    Min 1. Goblet Squat — 10 reps
    Min 2. Push-Up — 8-12 reps
    Min 3. DB Row — 8/side
    Min 4. Farmer Carry — 30-40 m
    Complete the work in ~35-45s; use the remainder of each minute as rest.

name: EMOM — Lower Body 24
description: Lower-body muscular endurance using simple squat, lunge and step patterns with controlled clock pressure.
coaching_notes: Local leg fatigue is intended; movement breakdown is not. Scale reps before load.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 24 min (6 rounds)
    Min 1. Goblet Squat — 12 reps
    Min 2. Reverse Lunge — 10 total
    Min 3. Step-Up — 10 total
    Min 4. Front Plank — 35s
    Preserve smooth reps and finish each work minute with recoverable time remaining.

name: EMOM — Upper Body 24
description: Push-pull upper-body endurance with enough rest to sustain quality across six cycles.
coaching_notes: Avoid early failure. Reps should remain within 1-3 reps of the opening round.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 24 min (6 rounds)
    Min 1. DB Bench Press — 10 reps
    Min 2. DB Row — 10/side
    Min 3. Push-Up — 8-12 reps
    Min 4. Farmer Carry — 30 m
    Use loads that keep every minute repeatable.

name: EMOM — Kettlebell Work Capacity 20
description: Kettlebell muscular endurance centered on repeatable ballistic and squat output.
coaching_notes: The clock creates repeatability, not urgency. Reduce reps if rest disappears.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 20 min (5 rounds)
    Min 1. Kettlebell Swing — 12 reps
    Min 2. Goblet Squat — 10 reps
    Min 3. Half-Kneeling 1-Arm Press — 6/side
    Min 4. Suitcase Carry — 25 m/side
    Maintain crisp swing mechanics and unbroken submaximal sets.

name: EMOM — Bodyweight Density 24
description: Equipment-free muscular endurance with simple patterns and sustainable repetition.
coaching_notes: Leave reps in reserve every minute. Shorten the crawl or reduce reps before form degrades.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 24 min (6 rounds)
    Min 1. Air Squat — 15 reps
    Min 2. Push-Up — 8-12 reps
    Min 3. Walking Lunge — 12 total
    Min 4. Bear Crawl — 20-30s
    Keep all sets submaximal and technically consistent.

name: EMOM — Dumbbell Push-Pull 24
description: Repeatable dumbbell push-pull endurance with trunk and grip support.
coaching_notes: Do not turn this into a max-rep test. The final round should resemble the first.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 24 min (6 rounds)
    Min 1. DB Floor Press — 10 reps
    Min 2. DB Row — 8/side
    Min 3. 1-Arm DB Overhead Press — 6/side
    Min 4. Suitcase Carry — 25 m/side
    Select loads that remain stable through all six rounds.

name: EMOM — Squat + Carry 20
description: Simple loaded muscular endurance emphasizing legs, trunk and grip.
coaching_notes: Use moderate loads. Continuous high-quality accumulation is the target.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 20 min (5 rounds)
    Min 1. DB Front-Rack Squat — 10 reps
    Min 2. Farmer Carry — 35 m
    Min 3. Reverse Lunge — 10 total
    Min 4. Pallof Press — 8/side
    Finish work with enough time to reset before the next minute.

name: EMOM — Power Endurance 18
description: Shorter technical EMOM for athletes who can sustain power-oriented dumbbell work without losing mechanics.
coaching_notes: Power quality governs loading. This is muscular endurance, not a conditioning sprint.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] EMOM, 18 min (6 rounds)
    Min 1. DB Hang Clean — 6 reps
    Min 2. Push Press — 6 reps
    Min 3. Goblet Squat — 10 reps
    Keep every set crisp; stop adding load once rep speed meaningfully drops.

name: Metcon — Dumbbell 5s
description: Full-body dumbbell metcon where local muscular fatigue, not running or transitions, is the primary limiter.
coaching_notes: Use one sustainable loading strategy. Avoid failure and keep round times within ~15%.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] rounds, 5 rounds
    1. DB Front-Rack Squat — 10 reps
    2. DB Bench Press — 10 reps
    3. DB Row — 10/side
    4. Farmer Carry — 40 m
    Rest 60s after each round.

name: Metcon — 12-10-8-6
description: Descending-rep muscular endurance with simple loaded and bodyweight patterns.
coaching_notes: Break sets before failure. The ladder should feel progressively more sustainable, not frantic.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] descending ladder, 12-10-8-6 reps
    1. Goblet Squat
    2. Push-Up
    3. DB Row — each side
    After each round: Suitcase Carry — 20 m/side
    Rest as needed to preserve clean sets.

name: Metcon — Lower Body Chipper
description: Lower-body chipper built around accumulated squat, lunge and step volume rather than race integration.
coaching_notes: Use manageable chunks from the start. Do not save all breaks for late-stage failure.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] chipper, complete in order
    1. Goblet Squat — 40 reps
    2. Walking Lunge — 40 total
    3. Step-Up — 30 total
    4. Air Squat — 40 reps
    5. Farmer Carry — 100 m
    Partition each movement as needed; quality remains the constraint.

name: Metcon — Upper Body Chipper
description: Upper-body push-pull volume challenge emphasizing sustainable muscular output.
coaching_notes: Submaximal chunks are the intended strategy. Keep shoulder mechanics clean.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] chipper, complete in order
    1. DB Bench Press — 40 reps
    2. DB Row — 30/side
    3. Push-Up — 30 reps
    4. Inverted Row — 30 reps
    5. Farmer Carry — 80 m
    Partition from the beginning to avoid muscular failure.

name: Metcon — Kettlebell Ladder
description: Kettlebell ladder combining ballistic, squat and press endurance without cardio-machine dependence.
coaching_notes: Do not sacrifice ballistic mechanics to finish a rung unbroken.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] ascending ladder, 4-6-8-10-12 reps
    1. Kettlebell Swing
    2. Goblet Squat
    3. Half-Kneeling 1-Arm Press — reps split evenly per side
    After each rung: Suitcase Carry — 20 m/side
    Rest 30-60s between rungs as needed.

name: Metcon — Bodyweight 20
description: Minimal-equipment muscular endurance using a repeatable bodyweight circuit.
coaching_notes: Score completed rounds plus reps, but pacing and repeatability take priority over speed.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] AMRAP, 20 min
    1. Air Squat — 15 reps
    2. Push-Up — 10 reps
    3. Reverse Lunge — 12 total
    4. Bear Crawl — 20s
    5. Front Plank — 30s
    Move steadily; stop sets before failure.

name: Metcon — Dumbbell Complex Endurance
description: Technical dumbbell muscular endurance using integrated movements at deliberately submaximal loads.
coaching_notes: Load for clean movement combinations, not maximal strength. Preserve the same movement standard each round.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] rounds, 5 rounds
    1. DB Clean + Front Squat — 6 reps
    2. DB Row — 8/side
    3. DB Front Squat + Press — 6 reps
    4. Suitcase Carry — 25 m/side
    Rest 75s after each round.

name: Metcon — Carry Builder
description: Carry-dominant muscular endurance emphasizing grip, trunk and leg fatigue resistance.
coaching_notes: Carry posture and grip quality govern load. Avoid racing the transitions.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] rounds, 6 rounds
    1. Farmer Carry — 50 m
    2. Goblet Squat — 12 reps
    3. DB Row — 8/side
    4. Reverse Lunge — 10 total
    Rest 45-60s after each round.

name: PIVOT Hero — Atlas
description: Long-form PIVOT benchmark for total-body muscular endurance using common dumbbell and bodyweight movements.
coaching_notes: Benchmark consistency matters more than maximal pace. Use the same movement standards on retest.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] 5 rounds for quality time
    1. Goblet Squat — 20 reps
    2. Push-Up — 15 reps
    3. DB Row — 12/side
    4. Walking Lunge — 20 total
    5. Farmer Carry — 60 m
    Record total time and loading for future comparison.

name: PIVOT Hero — Forge
description: Loaded benchmark emphasizing repeated squat, press, pull and carry output.
coaching_notes: Choose loads that permit all six rounds without technical failure.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] 6 rounds
    1. DB Front-Rack Squat — 12 reps
    2. DB Bench Press — 10 reps
    3. DB Row — 10/side
    4. Farmer Carry — 50 m
    Rest only as needed; record total time and loads.

name: PIVOT Hero — Long Haul
description: High-volume benchmark designed to test sustained muscular output with minimal equipment.
coaching_notes: Plan breaks before failure. This is a volume benchmark, not a test of reckless unbroken sets.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] chipper
    1. Air Squat — 100 reps
    2. Push-Up — 60 reps
    3. Walking Lunge — 80 total
    4. DB Row — 50/side
    5. Step-Up — 60 total
    6. Farmer Carry — 200 m
    Partition movements as needed; record total time.

name: PIVOT Hero — Iron Mile
description: Carry-centered PIVOT benchmark for grip, trunk and lower-body muscular endurance; no running required.
coaching_notes: Maintain carry posture and repeatable chunks. Grip failure should not force unsafe movement.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] 4 rounds
    1. Farmer Carry — 100 m
    2. Goblet Squat — 20 reps
    3. Reverse Lunge — 20 total
    4. Push-Up — 15 reps
    5. DB Row — 12/side
    Record total time and loads.

name: PIVOT Hero — Anvil
description: Technical dumbbell benchmark combining integrated movements with foundational muscular endurance.
coaching_notes: Use a load that preserves integrated-movement quality for the entire benchmark.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] 5 rounds
    1. DB Clean + Front Squat — 8 reps
    2. DB Floor Press — 12 reps
    3. DB Romanian Deadlift + Row — 8 reps
    4. Reverse Lunge — 16 total
    5. Suitcase Carry — 30 m/side
    Record total time and dumbbell load.

name: PIVOT Hero — Groundwork
description: Equipment-free benchmark for repeatable bodyweight muscular endurance.
coaching_notes: Scale reps before movement quality changes. Retests should use the same scaling.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] 8 rounds
    1. Air Squat — 20 reps
    2. Push-Up — 10 reps
    3. Walking Lunge — 16 total
    4. Bear Crawl — 20s
    5. Front Plank — 30s
    Record total time; preserve movement standards.

name: PIVOT Hero — Stronghold
description: Upper-body benchmark with sustained push, pull, grip and trunk output.
coaching_notes: Keep pushing and pulling volume balanced. Avoid muscular failure early.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] 6 rounds
    1. DB Bench Press — 12 reps
    2. DB Row — 12/side
    3. Push-Up — 10 reps
    4. Inverted Row — 10 reps
    5. Suitcase Carry — 30 m/side
    Record total time and loads.

name: PIVOT Hero — Redline
description: High-demand PIVOT benchmark for athletes with established dumbbell power-movement competency.
coaching_notes: Technical quality is the stop rule. This benchmark is not appropriate outside the athlete's technical-capacity envelope.
ref_prescription:
B1 [Main] 10 rounds
    1. DB Hang Clean — 6 reps
    2. Push Press — 6 reps
    3. Goblet Squat — 10 reps
    4. Farmer Carry — 30 m
    Rest only as needed to preserve power mechanics; record total time and load.
